title: Growing people
sub: Film 4 of Ownership and performance, the last of Leading data people: how people grow at work. Goals they help set, feedback every week about the work and its effect, never about who they are, and a next step with more to own.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: a Japanese schoolroom of the 1870s, then the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (Ivy's goals), orange is data (Teaching space use), green is something done (each goal met), and amber a risk (feedback that turns from the work to the person).
